product_overview: Sakan is a real estate platform for browsing properties, viewing them on maps, saving favorites, and making bookings. Authenticated users can also create, update, and delete their own property listings and upload property images.
core_goals: Enable users to browse and discover properties through a web application interface
Support user authentication and profile synchronization for secure access to protected actions
Allow authenticated users to manage property listings and upload listing images
Provide booking functionality for reserving properties
Let users add and remove properties from their favorites list

features.name: Main Application
features.description: Web application interface for accessing the Sakan platform
user_flows: GET / with no authentication -> Receive 200 HTML response rendering the main application interface
GET / with invalid or unavailable server state -> Receive non-200 error response indicating the page cannot be loaded

features.name: Authentication and Profiles
features.description: User signup, login, and profile synchronization including name and phone number storage in the profiles table
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signup with valid user details -> Receive 200/201 confirmation and authenticated session -> GET /api/profile with session token -> Receive 200 with synchronized profile data
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response and no session is created

features.name: Property Management
features.description: Create, edit, delete, and view property records for authenticated users
user_flows: POST /api/properties with valid authenticated session and property data -> Receive 201 with created property record -> GET /api/properties with session or public access as allowed -> Receive 200 with property list -> PATCH /api/properties/{id} with updated data -> Receive 200 with updated property
PATCH /api/properties/{id} without a valid auth session -> Receive 401/403 error due to RLS protection
DELETE /api/properties/{id} with valid authenticated owner session -> Receive 200/204 confirming deletion -> GET /api/properties/{id} -> Receive 404 or empty result for deleted property

features.name: Property Image Uploads
features.description: Upload and manage property images in the property-images storage bucket under each authenticated user's folder
user_flows: POST /api/properties/{id}/images with valid auth session and image file -> Receive 200/201 confirmation with image URL or storage path -> GET /api/properties/{id} -> Receive updated property details including uploaded image references
POST /api/properties/{id}/images without authentication or with an unauthorized user -> Receive 401/403 error and image upload is rejected

features.name: Bookings
features.description: Create booking records for properties and manage reservation requests
user_flows: POST /api/bookings with valid authenticated session and booking payload -> Receive 201 with booking confirmation -> GET /api/bookings with session token -> Receive 200 with the user's bookings
POST /api/bookings with missing required booking fields or invalid property reference -> Receive 400 validation error and no booking is created

features.name: Favorites
features.description: Add and remove properties from a user's favorites list
user_flows: POST /api/favorites with valid authenticated session and property id -> Receive 201/200 confirming favorite saved -> GET /api/favorites with session token -> Receive 200 with favorites list -> DELETE /api/favorites/{propertyId} -> Receive 200/204 confirming removal
POST /api/favorites without authentication -> Receive 401/403 error due to RLS and favorite is not created
